profile.headline: Web Professional | Helping SMBs reach their online goals
profile.summary:
Proven, professional web site designer, developer and manager of successful, interactive, standards compliant, and validated web sites, web applications, eCommerce solutions, databases, and digital marketing campaigns using a wide variety of tools and technologies. 

Over 20 years of website design, development and management experience, working with many clients, many platforms and many budgets.

Specialties: Web Project Management, Website Architecture, Web Design & Development, UI/UX, Accessibility & Usability, Technology Planning & Implementation, Theories & Design Approach Knowledge, Browser Compatibility, Brand/Image Creation & Development, E-commerce Initiatives & Realizations, Proficiency in Multiple Programming Languages, Content Creation, Excellent Time Management & Organizational Skills

positions.title: Owner | Web Developer
positions.description:
Website: https://siennawebdesigns.com

► We specialize in creating and managing successful websites and digital solutions. Our team of experienced designers and developers excels in crafting interactive, standards-compliant websites, web applications, eCommerce platforms, and databases using a diverse range of tools and technologies.
► Our goal is to deliver functional and innovative solutions that effectively showcase our clients’ products and services to their target audience.

Current list of Services:
► Website Health Checkup
► Virtual Webmaster Services
► Website Updates, Maintenance & Testing
► Website Security
► Website Repairs & Technical Support
► Technical SEO
► Web Accessibility
► Web Design
► Web Development
► Domain Names & Web Hosting
► Training

Some of the tools and technologies used over the past 25+ years: 
► HTML, XHTML, HTML5, DHTML, JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap
► CSS, CSS3, Responsive Web Design, Media Queries
► .NET, VB.NET, C#, Classic ASP, PHP, XML, JSON, RESTful API, AJAX, Web Services, Perl, CGI, Visual Studio
► SQL, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, Access, dBase
► IIS, Microsoft SQL Server, Windows &  Linux / Unix Server Platforms, cPanel, WHM, Plesk & Other Website Control Panels, Various FTP Software
► UI/UX Design, Adobe CS , Graphic design and Photo editing
► WooCommerce, Magento, Shopify and other eCommerce Shopping Cart Systems
► WordPress, Magento, Shopify, Sitefinity, Kentico and other Content Management Systems, 
► Various Mailing List and Marketing Software, Various Banner Ad Management Software
► Facebook, Twitter, Instagram and other Social Media platforms
► SEO, SEM, PPC
► Google Analytics, Omniture, Urchin, Webalizer
► Browser/Platform Constraints & Accessibility, Cross-Browser Compatibility/Testing
► Various Third-Party Software.

positions.title: Contractor | Web Developer
positions.description: Contracted to provide web development consultation & support to the company on a part-time basis.

positions.title: Contractor | Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
Contracted to help the company's management team create a new Web Services division from scratch.

► Analysis of competition, Web Services requirements gathering, research & planning, implementation of project plan and planning of future strategies of their new Web Service offerings.
► Creation of templates for web project requirements gathering documentation and Proposal Contract.
► Setup & maintenance of new VPS Web Hosting environment – Linux, WHM, cPanel.
► Creation of Base Wordpress Package containing required plugins and configured settings that could be easily duplicated and would cut future labor costs.
► Creation of several working demo websites that the company could use as proof of concept & future starter templates when talking to future potential clients – Wordpress & HTML5.
► Modification of the InnQuest Booking widget making it mobile-friendly and easily implemented.
► Acted as initial point of contact during initial phases, both internally and with clients, concerning sales, requirements gathering, specifications, proposal, cost estimation providing updates, design & development, QA testing, delivery, maintenance.
► Continued to provide web development consultation & support to the company on a part-time basis until sufficient staff was hired.

Tools and technologies used: Wordpress, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, PHP, Responsive Web Design, Media Queries, Bootstrap, UI/UX Design, Adobe CS, Browser/Platform Constraints & Accessibility, Cross-Browser Compatibility/Testing, MySQL, Linux, WHM, cPanel.

positions.title: Contractor | Web Developer
positions.description:
Contracted to help the company work through web development issues they were experiencing and also help them reduce their backlog of website-related deliverables.

During the contract, I assisted at varied levels on over 20 website projects and played an integral part on more than half; getting them built or fixed, QAed and eventually successfully launched.

Tools and technologies used: Wordpress, Magento, Shopify, ReadyShop Drop In Commerce, Movable Type, JavaScript, jQuery, PHP, HTML5, CSS3, Responsive Web Design, Media Queries, Bootstrap, UI/UX Design, Adobe CS, Browser/Platform Constraints & Accessibility, Cross-Browser Compatibility/Testing, MySQL.

positions.title: Contractor | Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
Contracted to fix, improve and implement several applications used company-wide.

► Fixed and improved an Electronic Guest Information web app written in ASP.NET MVC, C#, Bootstrap that is used daily at all of their locations.
► Integrated that Electronic Guest Information web app with Microsoft CRM so that data would get written to both systems when required.
► Led project through training where we configured their POS and DocuSign so that customer contracts could be digitally signed at all of their locations. 

Tools and technologies used: ASP.NET MVC, C#, SQL, LINQ, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, Toastr, HTML5, CSS3, JSON, Web Services, Responsive Web Design, Media Queries, Bootstrap, UI/UX Design, Adobe CS, Browser/Platform Constraints & Accessibility, Cross-Browser Compatibility/Testing, Visual Studio 2015, Team Foundation Server (TFS), Beyond Compare, Microsoft SQL Server, Microsoft CRM, DocuSign.

positions.title: Contractor | Mobile Web Developer
positions.description:
Hired by the owner to figure out what the company needed to do to make their websites and software products mobile-friendly. 

► Worked with members from various teams to figure out what was being done, why and then I created testable working samples of these new mobile-friendly solutions to prove that it could not only be done, but how to accomplish these huge tasks.
► Architected, developed, tested and documented mobile-friendly website solutions for several key areas of the company's workforce websites and software products.
► Worked daily with iOS & Android developers to advance mobile app products and incorporate some mobile-friendly website solutions into their apps to lower their maintenance workload.
► Assisted with any CSS related issues that arose by the Development team's everyday activities.
► Configured & implemented Google Analytics for over 75 of the company’s websites.

Tools and technologies used: ASP.NET, VB.NET, SQL, Classic ASP, Visual Studio 2013, Team Foundation Server (TFS), Beyond Compare, Microsoft SQL Server, JavaScript, jQuery, HTML5/XHTML, CSS3, Responsive Web Design, Bootstrap, UI/UX Design, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Dreamweaver, Browser/Platform Constraints & Accessibility, Cross-Browser Compatibility/Testing, Google Analytics, SmarterStats

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
► Managed day-to-day development & maintenance of all corporate websites, web-based applications & a suite of over 100 websites for internal departments and external clients. 
► Also served as our in-house Web Project Manager tasked with assisting Bayshore Solutions deliver Aspire's new front-facing corporate web presence as promised. 

Tools and technologies used: ASP.NET, VB.NET, C#, PHP, SQL, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, JavaScript, jQuery, HTML5, CSS3, Ajax, Bootstrap, Kendo UI, UI/UX Design, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Acrobat, Dreamweaver, Sitefinity CMS, Browser/Platform Constraints & Accessibility, Cross-Browser Compatibility/Testing, Google Analytics

positions.title: Manager, Digital Media
positions.description:
► Managed day-to-day operations of Buccaneers.com, the Glazer Family Foundation’s website, several other Glazer-owned websites, the Buccaneer’s intranet and other satellite websites. 
► Responsible for all web development and digital media related issues including Websites, Intranet, Servers, Databases, Mobile, Social, Advertising, Content Creation, SEO, Email Marketing, Audio/Video, Ecommerce and Analytics.
► Worked closely with partnered agencies and the NFL to provide a cohesive user experience and award winning digital strategy execution.
► Oversaw the execution of digital projects through implementation to ensure best practice, correct brand marketing, and user experience.
► Maintained several Legacy .NET/SQL applications.
► Monitored and analyzed web site statistics to aid in website optimization.
► Facilitated the needs of clients/partners in terms of required web assets such as videos, graphics, RSS feeds, etc. 
► Trained and monitored a small team and all content producers.

Tools and technologies used: HTML, XHTML, HTML 5, CSS, PHP, .NET, VB.NET, C#, MySQL, Microsoft SQL, XML, JavaScript, jQuery, UI/UX Design, Object-Oriented Programming, Structural Database Organization, WordPress and other Content Management Systems, Photoshop, Flash, ActionScript 2/3, Facebook, Twitter, and other Social Media platforms, SEO, SEM, Ominture, Browser/Platform Constraints & Accessibility, Cross-Browser Compatibility/Testing.

positions.title: Manager, Technology Marketing
positions.description:
► Identified opportunities to utilize IT more effectively in sales, customer service, and other key areas, arming managers with the knowledge they needed to choose wisely.
► Helped the entire company better use the technology available to them by identifying needs, creating training materials and rolling out various levels of training company-wide.
► Served as Developer & Project Manager on SharePoint 2010 implementation as well as several other successful projects, always within budget and on schedule.
► Assisted in redesign, development and transition of all company websites.
► Maintained all company websites & assisted, trained and oversaw all website users to maximize end user’s experience.
► Architected Veredus’ Social Media presence, translating business requirements into appropriate solutions, testing implementations as required.
► Managed Email Marketing & Email Lists.
► Performed as the company’s in-house marketing resource, creating graphics, implementing them into websites, email campaigns and marketing materials.
► Interacted with every level, helping all of them perform their jobs better and more effectively though their improved use of technology.

Tools and technologies used: XHTML, HTML, DHTML, CSS, JavaScript, .NET, C#, PHP, ASP, XML, MS SQL 2010, MySQL, IIS 7, Windows Server 2008, SharePoint 2010 Foundation, WordPress, MS Office, Graphic Design, Email Marketing, MS Visual Web Developer, MS Visual Studio 2010, MS SharePoint Designer, Photoshop, InDesign, Acrobat, Google Analytics, Social Media - Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, YouTube, Google+, ZoomInfo, Zoomerang, Constant Contact, Fuze Meeting, Ring Central, Video Creation & Editing, Vimeo, Dlvr.it, AddThis, Feedburner, Gliffy, QR Codes, Sendouts, TalentHook, Recon, Moodle, RSS, Indeed, Simply Hired, Monster, CareerBuilder, Dice, Talent Network, X-ray Searches

positions.title: Manager, Web Development
positions.description:
Sarasota Magazine, BIZ 941, Gulfshore Life Magazine, Gulfshore Business. 

► Managed day-to-day operations of all the company’s websites, email marketing campaigns, banner advertising, trained users in 2 locations and planned future web strategies. 
► Re-designed and developed all existing websites onto a new Kentico CMS / SQL Server platform and migrated all files & data onto company’s new Windows 2008 web server when company was purchased by new ownership.

Tools and technologies used: XHTML, DHTML, CSS, JavaScript, .NET, C#, PHP, ASP, VB, XML, MS SQL 2005/2008, MySQL, IIS6/7, Windows Server 2003/2008,  MS Access, MS Excel, Graphic Design, Email Marketing, MS Visual Web Developer, MS Visual Studio 2008, Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Acrobat, FLASH,  MS Word, MS Outlook, CrownPeak CMS, Kentico CMS, CHECKM8, Google Ad Server, OpenX, AdMentor, MailChimp, Publicaster, BlueToad, PollMonkey, Google Analytics, Social Media, eCommerce, Authorize.Net

positions.title: Director of Technical Resources
positions.description:
► Managed day-to-day operations of all the company’s websites and IT systems. 
► Being a small internet wholesale/retail company with 10 employees split-up between both coasts, my responsibilities also included marketing, future growth strategies, customer service, account management, packing, shipping and much more.

Tools and technologies used: HTML, JavaScript, Classic ASP, MS Access, MS Office, eCommerce Solutions - ecWare and StoreFront, Windows 2000, IIS, Digital photography, Photoshop, Email Marketing and List Management, SEO, Google Analytics, PPC.

positions.title: Assistant IT Administrator
positions.description:
► Worked under IT Administrator getting classes ready for scheduled courses the following day. 
► Main focus was on image deployment and configuration of course material to multiple computers and in multiple classrooms.
